# 17_05_2026

- added VPS suite runner diagnostics for per-run client logs, recent server logs, tc qdisc snapshots, timeout handling, and phase timing records under `results/raw/harness/runner/`
- taught the VPS suite runner to skip `docker compose build` when cached service images are newer than tracked build inputs, reducing repeated rerun cost
- coalesced demo-client wire header writes so each segment sends the length prefix and encoded header in one write before the payload
- added VOD continuity metrics to harness analysis and plotting so startup delay and rebuffer behavior can separate controllers even when raw usefulness stays flat
- added an AMC-only live ready-queue scheduler so semantics influence which released segment is sent next under constrained backlog
- recalibrated AMC utility-to-cwnd mapping and default window bounds so small runtime utility scores no longer force AMC into severe self-throttling on constrained live paths
- smoothed runtime utility updates and tapered cwnd growth as the window grows so AMC remains utility-aware while behaving more like a congestion controller than a pure priority amplifier
- made AMC controller behavior explicitly traffic-class-aware so live keeps the urgency bias while VOD probes more conservatively
- added optional coexistence runs in the harness plus fairness metrics for throughput share and Jain fairness index against a concurrent competitor flow
- fixed a QUIC response-delivery race in the standalone demo-server by waiting for the response stream to be acknowledged before endpoint shutdown
- synced the compose client command path so VPS matrix runs actually propagate the configured controller instead of silently defaulting every run to cubic
- added a VPS host-run fairness guardrail config that executes coexistence directly through the harness with tc on loopback because the legacy docker runner is still single-flow only
